Title: Azure Machine Learning - Public preview announcements Ignite, March 2021.

Body.Content:
At Ignite, March 2021, we're launching following public preview features: 

  • Interactive Data Preparation with Azure Synapse Analytics Managed Apache Spark clusters (backed by Synapse) for customers to perform interactive and performant data preparation for machine learning in Azure Machine Learning.  

  • Many model enhancements in Azure Machine Learning-used partitioned datasets and parallelize many models with ParallelRunStep.  

  • Setup scripts is coming soon, to provide an automated way to customize and configure compute at provisioning time.  

Learn more - Synapse and Azure ML.

Learn more - Many models.
